titles.title: To amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to allow accelerated depreciation for equipment used to manufacture advanced materials or to develop advanced technologies, to reduce capital gains taxes, and to impose a minimum tax on foreign and foreign-owned corporations operating in the United States.

To amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to allow accelerated depreciation for equipment used to manufacture advanced materials or to develop advanced technologies, to reduce capital gains taxes, and to impose a minimum tax on foreign and foreign-owned corporations operating in the United States.
